Get color string for a region code in a color lookup table.

Source: R/volume_regions.R
region_color.Rd

Get color string for a region code in a color lookup table.

Usage

region_color(colorlut, struct_idx)

Arguments

colorlut

a color lookup table data.frame, as returned by read.fs.colortable. Can be NULL if you do not have any, in that case the region names will just be 'region_x', where 'x' is the integer region code in the volatlas.

struct_idx

integer vector, the region / structure codes you are interested in.

Value

vector of character strings, the hex color names (like '#FF0000' for red).
